title: In the beginning
description: Introduces creation, origin, time, and God as prior to the created order.

title: Beginning
summary: The first point or origin of something.
description: Beginning creates the frame for creation, time, and purpose.

title: Creation
summary: The act of bringing existence into being.
description: Creation connects divine action, order, light, life, and the material world.

title: Light
summary: A symbol of illumination, revelation, life, and order.
description: Light appears at the start of creation and later becomes connected to truth and life.

title: Let there be light
description: Shows creation through speech and the appearance of light.
